title: Aadwik Production
prompt:
A little boy walks happily through a beautiful green garden on a sunny morning. Colorful butterflies flutter around him, and bright flowers sway gently in the breeze.

The boy notices a beautiful yellow butterfly sitting on a flower. He bends down, smiles, and says, “Hello, little friend!”

The butterfly flutters around his head. The boy laughs, looks toward the camera, waves his hand, and says, “Hello, friends! Come and explore with me!”

He walks toward a sparkling little stream as birds chirp and the trees sway gently.

The boy turns back, waves goodbye, and says, “See you soon!”

He walks happily into the magical garden as the scene fades out.

The End.

scenes.action: the star returns to the sky
